questions.questionText: A package in Dart is:
options: A set of organized files that can be used to build software
questions.correctAnswer: A set of organized files that can be used to build software
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A set of organized files that can be used to build software.

questions.questionText: Which of these is a default Dart package loaded automatically?
questions.correctAnswer: math
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) math.

questions.questionText: Besides default packages, Dart also allows:
questions.correctAnswer: Creation of user-defined packages
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Creation of user-defined packages.

questions.questionText: Why are packages needed?
options: To solve problems or add features without writing code from scratch
questions.correctAnswer: To solve problems or add features without writing code from scratch
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) To solve problems or add features without writing code from scratch.

questions.questionText: For a video-conferencing feature, the guide suggests:
options: Using an existing package that already handles it
questions.correctAnswer: Using an existing package that already handles it
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Using an existing package that already handles it.

questions.questionText: Packages generally contain:
options: Reusable code usable across several applications and platforms
questions.correctAnswer: Reusable code usable across several applications and platforms
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Reusable code usable across several applications and platforms.

questions.questionText: Dart package dependencies are published to and pulled from:
questions.correctAnswer: pub.dev
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) pub.dev.

questions.questionText: Packages other than the default ones must be:
options: Installed and explicitly loaded before use
questions.correctAnswer: Installed and explicitly loaded before use
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Installed and explicitly loaded before use.

questions.questionText: The pub get command is used to:
options: Get all the packages the application depends on
questions.correctAnswer: Get all the packages the application depends on
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Get all the packages the application depends on.

questions.questionText: The pub upgrade command is used to:
options: Upgrade all the packages the application depends on
questions.correctAnswer: Upgrade all the packages the application depends on
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Upgrade all the packages the application depends on.

questions.questionText: The pub help command:
questions.correctAnswer: Lists the available pub commands
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Lists the available pub commands.

questions.questionText: Dart packages are categorized by their:
questions.correctAnswer: Functionality
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Functionality.

questions.questionText: General-purpose packages are:
options: Used in almost all projects, e.g. handling JSON and making API calls
questions.correctAnswer: Used in almost all projects, e.g. handling JSON and making API calls
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Used in almost all projects, e.g. handling JSON and making API calls.

questions.questionText: The characters package is used for:
questions.correctAnswer: Manipulating Strings
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Manipulating Strings.

questions.questionText: The http package is used for:
questions.correctAnswer: Consuming HTTP resources
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Consuming HTTP resources.

questions.questionText: The intl package is used for:
questions.correctAnswer: Internationalization and localization
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Internationalization and localization.

questions.questionText: The json_serializable package:
options: Makes it easier to use code generation for JSON
questions.correctAnswer: Makes it easier to use code generation for JSON
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Makes it easier to use code generation for JSON.

questions.questionText: The path package is used to:
questions.correctAnswer: Manipulate path types
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Manipulate path types.

questions.questionText: The stack_trace package:
options: Parses and manipulates stack traces produced by Dart
questions.correctAnswer: Parses and manipulates stack traces produced by Dart
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Parses and manipulates stack traces produced by Dart.

questions.questionText: Which packages expand on core Dart libraries?
questions.correctAnswer: collection, io and async
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) collection, io and async.

questions.questionText: The collection package expands which library?
questions.correctAnswer: dart:collection
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) dart:collection.

questions.questionText: The io package is used to work with:
options: Files, sockets and other I/O support for server apps
questions.correctAnswer: Files, sockets and other I/O support for server apps
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Files, sockets and other I/O support for server apps.

questions.questionText: The async package adds:
options: Utility classes to make asynchronous computations easier
questions.correctAnswer: Utility classes to make asynchronous computations easier
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Utility classes to make asynchronous computations easier.

questions.questionText: Specialized packages are meant for:
questions.correctAnswer: Mobile (Flutter) and Web development
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Mobile (Flutter) and Web development.

questions.questionText: Plugin packages are:
options: Packages with an API written in Dart plus one or more platform-specific implementations
questions.correctAnswer: Packages with an API written in Dart plus one or more platform-specific implementations
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Packages with an API written in Dart plus one or more platform-specific implementations.

questions.questionText: Plugin packages can be written for:
options: iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux and the Web
questions.correctAnswer: iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux and the Web
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux and the Web.

questions.questionText: The Dart core library is:
options: A library that must always be installed manually
A built-in, automatically imported library providing List, Set, Map, DateTime and errors
questions.correctAnswer: A built-in, automatically imported library providing List, Set, Map, DateTime and errors
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) A built-in, automatically imported library providing List, Set, Map, DateTime and errors.

questions.questionText: Reading and writing a File is made available through which library?
questions.correctAnswer: dart:io
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) dart:io.

questions.questionText: Mathematical operations such as rounding off digits are available through:
questions.correctAnswer: dart:math
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) dart:math.

questions.questionText: Which command creates a simple Dart package named mypackage?
questions.correctAnswer: dart create --template=package-simple mypackage
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) dart create --template=package-simple mypackage.

questions.questionText: When the create command is used, the directory structure of the package is:
questions.correctAnswer: Created automatically
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Created automatically.

questions.questionText: Which of these files is NOT created along with a new package?
questions.correctAnswer: database.sql
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) database.sql.

questions.questionText: The pubspec.yaml file contains:
options: Metadata such as the package name, version and description
questions.correctAnswer: Metadata such as the package name, version and description
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Metadata such as the package name, version and description.

questions.questionText: pubspec.yaml is also used to:
options: Download the libraries required by the application
questions.correctAnswer: Download the libraries required by the application
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Download the libraries required by the application.

questions.questionText: The name field in pubspec.yaml specifies:
options: The package name and how to import files inside the project
questions.correctAnswer: The package name and how to import files inside the project
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The package name and how to import files inside the project.

questions.questionText: Which statement imports a file from within a package project?
questions.correctAnswer: import 'package:mypackage/main.dart';
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) import 'package:mypackage/main.dart';.

questions.questionText: The description field in pubspec.yaml is:
options: Optional and shown publicly when published on pub.dev
questions.correctAnswer: Optional and shown publicly when published on pub.dev
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Optional and shown publicly when published on pub.dev.

questions.questionText: The version field is used to:
options: Give a version to the application or library
questions.correctAnswer: Give a version to the application or library
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Give a version to the application or library.

questions.questionText: The environment field in pubspec.yaml:
options: Adds constraints on the Dart SDK version
questions.correctAnswer: Adds constraints on the Dart SDK version
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Adds constraints on the Dart SDK version.

questions.questionText: sdk: '>=2.16.1 <3.0.0' means the application runs on:
options: SDK versions from 2.16.1 up to but not including 3.0.0
questions.correctAnswer: SDK versions from 2.16.1 up to but not including 3.0.0
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) SDK versions from 2.16.1 up to but not including 3.0.0.

questions.questionText: If the SDK version is incompatible with the packages used, the code:
options: Fails to compile with a version solving failed error
questions.correctAnswer: Fails to compile with a version solving failed error
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Fails to compile with a version solving failed error.

questions.questionText: The dev_dependencies field specifies:
questions.correctAnswer: Dependencies needed only during development
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Dependencies needed only during development.

questions.questionText: The .gitignore file tells Git:
options: Which files to include in the app
Which files to ignore when the project is committed
questions.correctAnswer: Which files to ignore when the project is committed
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Which files to ignore when the project is committed.

questions.questionText: The README.md file:
options: Describes the package and appears on its landing page on pub.dev
questions.correctAnswer: Describes the package and appears on its landing page on pub.dev
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Describes the package and appears on its landing page on pub.dev.

questions.questionText: The CHANGELOG.md file:
options: Tracks changes made to the project, organized by date and version
questions.correctAnswer: Tracks changes made to the project, organized by date and version
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Tracks changes made to the project, organized by date and version.

questions.questionText: A locally available user-defined package is added to another project by:
options: Copying it by hand into main()
Adding a path dependency in pubspec.yaml
questions.correctAnswer: Adding a path dependency in pubspec.yaml
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Adding a path dependency in pubspec.yaml.

questions.questionText: Which command updates the dependencies of a project?
questions.correctAnswer: dart pub get
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) dart pub get.

questions.questionText: Which line imports the user-defined package in the sample project?
questions.correctAnswer: import 'package:mypackage/mypackage.dart';
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) import 'package:mypackage/mypackage.dart';.

questions.questionText: Which command runs the sample project file?
questions.correctAnswer: dart run lib/sample_dart_project.dart
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) dart run lib/sample_dart_project.dart.

questions.questionText: If Arithmetic.divide(int a, int b) returns a / b with a = 10 and b = 6, the printed result is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) 1.6666666666666667.
